hunk_reviews.judgment: Review all42 hunks of the complete bottom-sheet spec migration. Pair58 static cases;23 callback semantics are unchanged and35 fakeAsync bodies become native async. The new exact Promise/setTimeout helper supplies26 zero-ms waits;17 viewContainerFixture.whenStable calls and15 extra detection calls are added.37 flush, four flushMicrotasks and11 tick operations (including four500ms and six1000ms waits) disappear.57 predicates remain exact; the quick-succession case removes its explicit not.toThrow scope around the three-open loop and flush, then waits for stability in an async body. This changed observation/error boundary is individually pinned, not called equivalent. Opening/dismissed streams, data, parent/child service ownership, backdrop/escape, focus restoration and focus moved during animation retain their recorded nonboundary operations with changed observation timing. Four setup callbacks also become async; all six hooks and14 fixture classes/templates are accounted for. Decline this private test-harness migration and preserve public peer interoperability without an ordinary component/animation fork. There is no owned legacy bottom-sheet TypeScript family; that is not a reachability exclusion: Cyph imports MatBottomSheetModule, opens sheets from its material-dialog service and dismisses MatBottomSheetRef from dialog-confirm. Keep the existing owned historical M2 bottom-sheet Sass and consumer structure; no API or CSS/SCSS change is required. Actual mixed peer/legacy consumer, focus/lifetime, packed/browser and both-floor evidence remains pending.
